spec.objective: Produce a pure CorpusStats analytics layer over the three snapshot JSONs plus our PoC ground-truth: per-(repo,CWE) saturation, per-repo expected value (via existing expected_payout), program_health from pool_note, and a CWE pipeline_capability map.
functional_requirements: Define the CorpusStats dataclass with fields saturation: dict[tuple[str,str],float], expected_value: dict[str,float], program_health: dict[str,str], pipeline_capability: dict[str,str].
Expose compute_corpus_stats(repo_bounties: dict, existing_submissions: dict, poc_dir: str) -> CorpusStats.
Compute per-(repo,CWE) saturation by labeling existing_submissions titles via classify_title and aggregating per repo.
Compute per-repo expected_value by calling ngv2.prioritize.expected_payout (no reimplementation of payout math).
Parse program_health per repo from its pool_note field.
Build pipeline_capability[cwe] with values constrained to {'scannable+confirmable','scannable','none'}.
Read PoC ground-truth CWE labels from poc_dir markdown '### 5. CWE' fields; keep the module pure with no network/fetch and no snapshot writes.
spec.interfaces: compute_corpus_stats(repo_bounties: dict, existing_submissions: dict, poc_dir: str) -> CorpusStats; CorpusStats(saturation: dict[tuple[str,str],float], expected_value: dict[str,float], program_health: dict[str,str], pipeline_capability: dict[str,str])
edge_cases: Empty repo_bounties and existing_submissions yield a CorpusStats with empty dicts (no raise).
A repo whose pool_note is missing/empty maps to a defined default program_health rather than raising.
A CWE with no scanner/confirmer coverage maps to pipeline_capability 'none'.
A poc_dir with no '### 5. CWE' markdown sections contributes no PoC ground-truth labels.
non_goals: No integration test required: per the epic Non-Goals this child carries the literal word integration, excusing the integration-test requirement for this pure-analytics leaf.
Do NOT reimplement expected_payout — call the existing ngv2.prioritize.expected_payout.
No network/fetch work, no snapshot writing, no sink-taxonomy building, no selection_ranker changes, no auto-submission.

## tests/test_bounty_corpus_stats_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle: ngv2/bounty_corpus_stats.py — pure CorpusStats analytics.

Contract (from brief_hooks_title-cwe-and-corpus-stats):
    compute_corpus_stats(repo_bounties: dict, existing_submissions: dict,
                         poc_dir: str) -> CorpusStats

* ``repo_bounties`` is the FULL huntr_repo_bounties.json snapshot shape:
  ``{"repos": {"owner/repo": {eligible, tier, observed_payouts{...}, max_paid,
  total_advisories, submissions, pool_note}}}``.
* ``existing_submissions`` is the FULL huntr_existing_submissions.json shape:
  ``{"owner/repo": {"status": int, "count": int, "titles": [str, ...]}}``.
* ``poc_dir`` is a directory shaped like data/ngv2/poc_submissions/
  (``<repo>/<id>_submission.md`` files carrying a ``CWE-NNN:`` line).

CorpusStats is a dataclass with fields:
    saturation: dict[tuple[str, str], float]   # (repo, cwe) -> prior-sub pressure
    expected_value: dict[str, float]           # repo -> EV (reuses prioritize.expected_payout)
    program_health: dict[str, str]             # repo -> health parsed from pool_note
    pipeline_capability: dict[str, str]        # cwe -> capability tier

pipeline_capability values are exactly in {'scannable+confirmable', 'scannable',
'none'}. Today: CWE-78 and CWE-502 are scannable+confirmable (pattern_scanner /
deser_detect exist and the PoC+jail pipeline confirms them); CWE-918 and CWE-22
have no detector yet -> 'none'.

Pure: no network, no clock, no randomness. Never raises on empty inputs.
"""
import dataclasses

from ngv2.bounty_corpus_stats import CorpusStats, compute_corpus_stats

REPO_BOUNTIES = {
    "repos": {
        "alpha/one": {
            "eligible": True,
            "tier": "B",
            "observed_payouts": {"critical": 1200, "high": 600, "medium": 100, "low": 15},
            "max_paid": 1200,
            "total_advisories": 28,
            "submissions": 28,
            "pool_note": "Active, well-funded program",
        },
        "beta/two": {
            "eligible": True,
            "tier": "D_custom",
            "observed_payouts": {"critical": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0},
            "max_paid": 0,
            "total_advisories": 2,
            "submissions": 2,
            "pool_note": "Pool shows $0 across all severities. Program may be paused.",
        },
    }
}

EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS = {
    "alpha/one": {
        "status": 200,
        "count": 2,
        "titles": [
            "OS Command Injection in runner",
            "Command injection via crafted filename",
        ],
    },
    "beta/two": {
        "status": 200,
        "count": 1,
        "titles": ["Unsafe pickle deserialization in loader"],
    },
}


def _make_poc_dir(tmp_path):
    repo_dir = tmp_path / "gptcache"
    repo_dir.mkdir()
    (repo_dir / "GPC-1_submission.md").write_text(
        "# Submission\nCWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return tmp_path


def test_returns_corpus_stats_dataclass(tmp_path):
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(REPO_BOUNTIES, EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS, str(_make_poc_dir(tmp_path)))
    assert isinstance(stats, CorpusStats)
    assert dataclasses.is_dataclass(stats)
    assert isinstance(stats.saturation, dict)
    assert isinstance(stats.expected_value, dict)
    assert isinstance(stats.program_health, dict)
    assert isinstance(stats.pipeline_capability, dict)


def test_saturation_is_per_repo_cwe(tmp_path):
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(REPO_BOUNTIES, EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS, str(_make_poc_dir(tmp_path)))
    # alpha/one has two prior CWE-78 submissions -> positive saturation there
    assert stats.saturation.get(("alpha/one", "CWE-78"), 0) > 0
    # beta/two has one prior CWE-502 submission -> positive saturation there
    assert stats.saturation.get(("beta/two", "CWE-502"), 0) > 0
    # alpha/one has NO prior CWE-502 submission -> zero/absent saturation
    assert stats.saturation.get(("alpha/one", "CWE-502"), 0) == 0


def test_expected_value_reflects_observed_payouts(tmp_path):
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(REPO_BOUNTIES, EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS, str(_make_poc_dir(tmp_path)))
    assert stats.expected_value["alpha/one"] > 0
    assert stats.expected_value["beta/two"] == 0
    assert stats.expected_value["alpha/one"] > stats.expected_value["beta/two"]


def test_program_health_parsed_from_pool_note(tmp_path):
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(REPO_BOUNTIES, EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS, str(_make_poc_dir(tmp_path)))
    assert set(stats.program_health) >= {"alpha/one", "beta/two"}
    for value in stats.program_health.values():
        assert isinstance(value, str) and value
    # an active well-funded pool must not be classified identically to a $0/paused pool
    assert stats.program_health["alpha/one"] != stats.program_health["beta/two"]


def test_pipeline_capability_map(tmp_path):
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(REPO_BOUNTIES, EXISTING_SUBMISSIONS, str(_make_poc_dir(tmp_path)))
    allowed = {"scannable+confirmable", "scannable", "none"}
    assert set(stats.pipeline_capability.values()) <= allowed
    assert stats.pipeline_capability.get("CWE-78") == "scannable+confirmable"
    assert stats.pipeline_capability.get("CWE-502") == "scannable+confirmable"
    assert stats.pipeline_capability.get("CWE-918") == "none"
    assert stats.pipeline_capability.get("CWE-22") == "none"


# edge_case: empty inputs produce an empty-but-valid CorpusStats, never raises
def test_empty_inputs_do_not_raise(tmp_path):
    empty_dir = tmp_path / "empty"
    empty_dir.mkdir()
    stats = compute_corpus_stats({}, {}, str(empty_dir))
    assert isinstance(stats, CorpusStats)
    assert stats.saturation == {}
    assert stats.expected_value == {}
    assert stats.program_health == {}


# edge_case: malformed snapshot (missing 'repos' key / junk entries) is skipped, not raised
def test_malformed_snapshot_is_tolerated(tmp_path):
    empty_dir = tmp_path / "empty2"
    empty_dir.mkdir()
    stats = compute_corpus_stats(
        {"unexpected": 1}, {"alpha/one": "not-a-dict"}, str(empty_dir)
    )
    assert isinstance(stats, CorpusStats)

```

"""RED oracle: additive CWE fix in ngv2/novelty_corpus.py.

Contract (from brief_hooks_title-cwe-and-corpus-stats): where
``corpus_from_submissions_map`` / ``load_known_corpus`` currently flatten every
title with ``'cwe': ''``, the ``cwe`` field must instead be populated via
``ngv2.title_cwe_classifier.classify_title`` so the per-finding class signal is
preserved. Everything else stays behavior-compatible: entry shape
``{'title', 'cwe', 'file', 'repo'}``, malformed shapes skipped (never raised),
missing/unparseable file -> [].
"""
import json

from ngv2.novelty_corpus import corpus_from_submissions_map, load_known_corpus


def test_classifiable_title_gets_cwe_populated():
    data = {"beta/two": {"titles": ["Unsafe pickle deserialization in loader"]}}
    entries = corpus_from_submissions_map(data)
    assert len(entries) == 1
    assert entries[0]["cwe"] == "CWE-502"
    # behavior-compatible remainder of the entry shape
    assert entries[0]["title"] == "Unsafe pickle deserialization in loader"
    assert entries[0]["file"] == "beta/two"
    assert entries[0]["repo"] == "beta/two"


def test_command_injection_title_gets_cwe_78():
    data = {"alpha/one": {"titles": ["OS Command Injection in runner"]}}
    entries = corpus_from_submissions_map(data)
    assert entries[0]["cwe"] == "CWE-78"


# edge_case: unclassifiable title keeps cwe == '' (no false-positive class)
def test_unclassifiable_title_keeps_empty_cwe():
    data = {"alpha/one": {"titles": ["Bump dependency versions in changelog"]}}
    entries = corpus_from_submissions_map(data)
    assert entries[0]["cwe"] == ""


# edge_case: malformed shapes are still skipped, never raised
def test_malformed_shapes_still_skipped():
    data = {
        "ok/repo": {"titles": ["Path Traversal in download"]},
        "bad/repo1": "not-a-dict",
        "bad/repo2": {"titles": "not-a-list"},
        "bad/repo3": {"titles": [42, None]},
    }
    entries = corpus_from_submissions_map(data)
    assert [e["repo"] for e in entries] == ["ok/repo"]
    assert entries[0]["cwe"] == "CWE-22"


def test_load_known_corpus_populates_cwe(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "subs.json"
    p.write_text(
        json.dumps({"r/x": {"status": 200, "count": 1, "titles": ["SSRF via unvalidated redirect URL"]}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    entries = load_known_corpus(p)
    assert len(entries) == 1
    assert entries[0]["cwe"] == "CWE-918"


def test_load_known_corpus_missing_file_still_empty(tmp_path):
    assert load_known_corpus(tmp_path / "nope.json") == []
